item.description: Welcome to Season 2 Episode 26 of the Film Room Podcast! item.title: Susquehanna County Promotion and Tourism Agency awarded $5,000 grant
item.description: Staci Wilson, director of the Susquehanna County Promotion & Tourism Agency, received a $5,000 Semiquin Grant from America250PA supporting the inaugural Susquehanna County Heritage Trail from Leo Malsky, America250PA director of operations. Attending the presentation were, from left: Cindy Wooden, Center for Anti-Slavery Studies; Malsky; Bonnie Yuscavage, director of the Susquehanna County Historical Society; Amanda Lavan, America250Pa; Wilson; and Roseann Swegel, Forest City Historical Society.

item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Matthew Alemdina, Mid Valley wrestling
item.description: At the District 2 Class 2A Wrestling Championships, Mid Valley senior Matthew Almedina captured his fourth straight district title and second consecutive Outstanding Wrestler award. He had two technical falls and two pins at 139 pounds. In the Round of 16, he won by technical fall over Valley View’s Cooper Rawlings, 16-1, in 1:01. item.title: D2 BOYS BASKETBALL: Valley View seeks trip to Class 4A state playoffs
item.description: Valley View must quickly shake off the heartbreak of losing, 46-43, on a buzzer-beater if it wants to reach the PIAA Class 4A boys basketball playoffs. item.title: New Milford Area Rotary honors Stephen Spero
item.description: The Green Gables Restaurant at New Milford was the venue for a formal Paul Harris Fellow award presentation during a regular meeting of the New Milford Area Rotary in October. Club member Stephen Spero was presented with his third Paul Harris Fellow award in recognition of his in-kind contributions and volunteer efforts over many years as project chair for the annual Blueberry Festival.
